name: Type selector
description: Selects all elements of a given HTML tag name.

name: .class
description: Selects all elements that have the given class in their class attribute.
notes: An element can have multiple classes separated by spaces in its class attribute.

name: #id
description: Selects the single element with the matching id attribute.
notes: IDs must be unique per page and have high specificity — prefer classes for reusable styling.

name: Universal selector (*)
description: Selects every element on the page.
notes: Commonly used in CSS resets; can hurt performance if used with heavy rules on large DOM trees.

name: Attribute selector
description: Selects elements based on the presence or value of an HTML attribute.
parameters: ^= starts with, $= ends with, *= contains, ~= contains word.

name: Descendant combinator
description: Selects elements that are nested anywhere inside an ancestor element, at any depth.

name: Child combinator (>)
description: Selects only direct children of an element, not deeper descendants.

name: Adjacent sibling combinator (+)
description: Selects the element that comes immediately after another element and shares the same parent.

name: General sibling combinator (~)
description: Selects all siblings that come after an element and share the same parent, not just the immediately adjacent one.

name: Grouping selector (,)
description: Applies the same declaration block to multiple selectors, comma-separated.

name: :hover
description: Applies styles while the pointer is positioned over an element.
notes: Has no effect on touch-only devices since there is no persistent hover state.

name: :focus
description: Applies styles to an element while it has keyboard or programmatic focus.
notes: Never remove focus outlines without providing an equally visible replacement — it breaks keyboard accessibility.

name: :active
description: Applies styles while an element is being activated, such as during a mouse click or tap.

name: :nth-child()
description: Selects elements based on their position among siblings, counting all sibling element types.
parameters: An+B formula, or the keywords odd/even, or a fixed integer position.

name: :nth-of-type()
description: Selects elements based on their position among siblings of the same element type, ignoring other tag types.
notes: Unlike :nth-child(), it only counts siblings that share the same tag name.

name: :first-child / :last-child
description: Selects an element only if it is the first or last child of its parent, respectively.

name: :not()
description: Selects elements that do not match the selector passed as its argument.
parameters: exception — any simple selector to exclude.

name: :checked
description: Matches checkboxes, radio buttons, or options that are currently checked or selected.
notes: Often combined with the sibling combinator to build CSS-only toggle UI.

name: ::before
description: Inserts generated content immediately before an element's actual content.
notes: Requires a content property to render, even if the value is an empty string.

name: ::after
description: Inserts generated content immediately after an element's actual content.

name: ::placeholder
description: Styles the placeholder text of a form input or textarea.
